_readme: ROADMAP M1 asks for 20 measured real Indian meals. THIS SET HAS 2.
Only assets/onboarding/food_palak_paneer.jpg is a real Indian meal photo
in the repo. hero_bowl.jpg is a Western styled stock image and is here on
purpose as a HALLUCINATION PROBE: a model that has learned to always
answer with an Indian dish will fail it. food_scan.jpg is a mock of a
phone scanning a packaged noodle bowl, not a plated meal - excluded.
The 20-photo set has to come from a human (the owner or the 12 testers),
because the app's users take the photos. Do not pad this file with stock
art to make the number look better; that would defeat the milestone.
kcal values are IFCT-style reference figures for a normal home serving,
not laboratory measurements, so 'kcal error' is error against a reference
band. Read it as a trend between runs.

cases.note: Real plate: one katori palak paneer + one roti, photographed from above.
OUT OF SCOPE on purpose. Chickpeas, avocado, tomato, cucumber, greens. No Indian dish is present; any Indian answer here is an invention.
